$comment: Every Flexarr app and platform, shown at flexarr.io/apps (in this order) and served as flexarr.io/apps.json. kind: server | player | integration (the section the page shows it in). Edit this file, then run `make apps`. status: available | beta | coming | development | planned. The first link is the card's main button. Entries with "release": "server" get the server's version from scripts/release.sh; set the others by hand when a store build goes live.

platforms.name: Server + Web Player
platforms.summary: Reads your films, TV, music and podcasts, works with Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr, and streams to every app. The web player is built in: open your server's address in any browser.

platforms.name: iPhone and iPad
platforms.summary: Downloads for offline, podcasts with widgets and alerts, Siri, Picture in Picture and AirPlay.

platforms.name: Apple TV
platforms.summary: Your libraries, music and live TV from the sofa, with a player built for HDR and Atmos.
platforms.note: With Apple for review. Can't wait?

platforms.name: Mac
platforms.summary: Your libraries in a Mac window, a full-screen player with Picture in Picture and AirPlay, and downloads for away from home.

platforms.name: Home Assistant
platforms.summary: Every Apple TV, iPhone and iPad becomes a media player, so your home can react to what you're watching: lights down when a film starts.

platforms.name: Android phone and tablet
platforms.summary: A native app for Android phones and tablets, with downloads for offline and podcasts.
platforms.note: Until then, the web player works in your phone's browser.

platforms.name: Android TV and Google TV
platforms.summary: Flexarr on the big screen, for TVs and streaming sticks with Google TV or Android TV.
platforms.note: Built on the Android app, and laid out like the Apple TV app.
